text: January 28, 2021 Dear [Insert Jazz Fest people], We are the brothers of Phi Mu Alpha Sinfonia Fraternity, Beta Sigma Chapter, here at the University of Idaho. As many of you may know, a staple of our Fraternity’s mission is to advance music in America. For over 10 years, the Lionel Hampton Jazz Festival has been a way in which we have spread our mission through volunteer work as a group to adopt festival sites, and individual work as volunteer drivers, workers in the various tech crews, and in other work needed as the week goes on. We are so excited that the festival will still be put on, in a safe manner, so that there is still advancement of music in America from our great university. As a brotherhood, something we have pondered about this year is, how can we give to the Jazz Festival in a meaningful and outward way? Seeing that there will be no physical solo/ensemble sites, concerts, or workshops, we began to think about other areas that we could advance music while still staying safe. We noticed that on the festival website, there were donation tiers that would gain individuals or organizations some perks such as special times to order tickets, or having logos present within the festival. After speaking with the brothers, we feel that donating to the festival from our chapter funds would be very beneficial, though at the level we would like to donate, there isn’t any special tier for. This brings us to why we are writing to you. We would like to commit to donating $______ to the Lionel Hampton Jazz Festival this year, but we would like to ask if there would be any way to digitally upload our logo and name to any of the Jazz Festival events and/or web pages in return. We respect that often times those types of advertising do require a higher tier of donating. Seeing that our Fraternity has been so closely tied to high levels of volunteer work over the past 10 years, at least, within the Lionel Hampton School of Music, as a student organization, we wanted to extend this request to you. The Lionel Hampton Jazz Festival, and School of Music, are integral pieces to both the University of Idaho and our chapter of Phi Mu Alpha Sinfonia Fraternity. We would greatly appreciate your consideration and look forward to continue our joint desire to advance music in America. Musically yours, [Insert how to sign] Phi Mu Alpha Sinfonia Fraternity Beta Sigma Chapter University of Idaho
